title: Beyond Microservices: Testing Web-Scale RCA Methods on GPU-Driven LLM Workloads
observer_permissions: Authorized deployment operator: per-Pod resource/GPU/latency metrics; trace and log branches additionally use instrumentation. Injection timestamp supplied, fault location not supplied.
signal_origin: LLM-serving resource contention and execution telemetry
observation_layer: Operator instrumentation: metrics, request traces and logs; core qualifying branch is metric-only
hidden_property: Which of six candidate Pods is the root-cause location of an injected resource/network fault
exploitation_goal: Authorized fault localization; not confidentiality attack
evaluation_conditions: Live Falcon-H1-7B-Instruct on Ray/vLLM, one head and three workers; CPU/memory/network/GPU faults, ten injections per worker per type, 120 total; six candidate Pods. Five-minute pre-fault and one-minute fault telemetry plus known injection time.
evidence_boundary: One instrumented LLM deployment, controlled one-fault-at-a-time diagnosis. Known onset, privileged telemetry, no passive-network privacy inference or unseen-deployment result.
RQ1: Hidden execution/fault-location state, not a private user goal
RQ2: Specified privileged operator observations; authorization does not negate observability
RQ3: Transfer of 24 existing RCA methods to real LLM-serving telemetry; metric-only performance depends strongly on fault type, and trace instrumentation can miss decisive dependencies
RQ4: Diagnosis, not suppression of observer inference; privacy-defense retraining/utility frontier NA
decision_reason: C1 real Falcon-H1-7B-Instruct deployment, not an LLM analyst of ordinary microservices; C2 faulty Pod is hidden despite supplied fault onset; C3 separately evaluated metric-only auxiliary resource/GPU/latency inference; C4 documented authorized operator access satisfies the permission criterion; C5 120 controlled injections evaluated by 24 RCA methods. Correct the old ADJACENT diagnosis classification; do not introduce a low-privilege requirement.
trace_source: Prometheus/Ray-vLLM metrics; Fluent Bit/Loki logs; DeepFlow eBPF traces
system_sample_split: Falcon-H1-7B-Instruct, three Ray workers; four fault types x three workers x ten trials=120. Six candidate Pods; independent held-out deployment NR-R in inspected Sections4-5.
method: 20 metric, two trace and two multi-source RCA methods; hidden root-cause Pod ranking from pre/post telemetry and known injection timestamp; some metric methods also receive communication DAG.
metric_result: Table1 AC@1 among six candidates: NSigma CPU1.00/memory.70/network.93/GPU.17; CIRCA .40/.80/.70/.20. MicroRank AC@1 zero for all four fault types; TraceRCA .03/0/0/0. This is diagnosis accuracy, not privacy-leakage accuracy.
baselines_generalization: 24 RCA methods and random strategy; fault-type-dependent failure of transfer from ordinary microservice methods; one LLM deployment, no general agent/privacy population inference.
statistics: 30 injections per fault type; reported aggregate ranking scores. Non-convergent methods fall back to random selection. No uncertainty interval located in inspected Sections4-5/Table1.
defense_retraining_cost_utility: NA for privacy defense; no same-run leakage/utility frontier
artifact: https://github.com/exalsius/rca-llm linked by source; repository/run binding and reproduction not verified
limits_todos: Retain controlled-fault and privileged-observer scope; publisher DOI10.1145/3777911.3800637 equivalence NR-V; artifact not executed.

title: Reading Between the Lines: Towards Reliable Black-box LLM Fingerprinting via Zeroth-order Gradient Estimation
observer_permissions: Active black-box query access to source and suspicious models; generated response content is available
signal_origin: Semantic response embeddings under input word-substitution probes
evaluation_conditions: LeaFBench: seven foundation families,149 instances,1.1B-14B; default two base queries plus four variants each,20 repeats=200 calls/model; sentence embedding all-mpnet-base-v2.
evidence_boundary: Behavioral content fingerprinting; the estimated Jacobian is computed from input/output embedding changes, not directly observed gradients or an isolated runtime auxiliary channel.
RQ1: Model provenance as adjacent identity target
RQ2: Active input/output content receiver, not passive metadata receiver
RQ3: Response-embedding fingerprint comparisons; do not transfer content-based robustness to traffic or tool-metadata inference
RQ4: Privacy-defense retraining/utility frontier NA; adaptive fingerprint obfuscation is a different objective
decision_rule: C1-C5 component adjudication; C3 semantics boundary
decision_reason: C1,C2,C4,C5 apply to empirical model-provenance auditing, but C3 is not established for a separately evaluated auxiliary execution observable: query and response contents are embedded, and a Jacobian is estimated from their differences. Keep adjacent consistently with content-based identity comparators; supersede old CORE proposal without denying its identity-auditing value.
trace_source: Generated query-response texts, embedded locally by auditor
system_sample_split: LeaFBench149 instances; pairwise provenance discrimination across seven source families. Detailed evaluation partition/uncertainty not re-extracted.
method: Semantic-preserving word substitutions, repeated output embedding averages, regression-based zeroth-order Jacobian estimation and fingerprint similarity
metric_result: Section5.2 reports AUC .720 and pAUC .683 under200 calls/model; not an auxiliary-metadata leakage score.
baselines_generalization: LLMmap,MET,SEF,TRAP and white-box REEF; post-development variants. Does not establish passive observer transfer.
statistics: AUC,pAUC with FPR0-.05,TPR at1%FPR and Mahalanobis distance; confidence intervals NR-V in this scoped extraction.
defense_retraining_cost_utility: Privacy-defense frontier NA; detailed adaptive attack/overhead fields outside this extraction remain NR-V
artifact: NR-V: artifact not verified or executed in this reconciliation
limits_todos: Avoid treating approximate semantic Jacobian as measured internal execution gradient; publisher DOI10.1145/3774904.3792196 exact-version equivalence NR-V.

title: Behavioral Fingerprints for LLM Endpoint Stability and Identity
observer_permissions: Active API probing using fixed prompts; observes generated response contents over time
exploitation_goal: Authorized endpoint stability and identity monitoring
evaluation_conditions: 800 calls/fingerprint; controlled family/version/engine/quantization/temperature changes and real provider comparisons; hourly monitoring in controlled experiment.
evidence_boundary: Content-distribution fingerprinting. Operational latency/error plots are context, not the evaluated fingerprint's sole features; no isolated auxiliary-only inference established.
RQ3: Controlled deployment changes can alter content fingerprints; does not establish equivalent metadata or network-traffic transfer
RQ4: Stability monitoring is not defense suppressing secret inference; privacy utility-cost frontier NA
decision_rule: C1-C5 component adjudication; C3 semantics boundary
decision_reason: C1,C2,C4,C5 establish measured endpoint identity/change monitoring, but C3 auxiliary-only component is not established: the statistic compares response embeddings. Keep as adjacent rather than counting ordinary output semantics alone as an execution-side-channel component; authorization is not the exclusion reason.
system_sample_split: Controlled single-factor endpoint changes; selected same-model providers over matched time windows. Complete repeated-trial denominator/partition NR-V for this scoped extraction.
method: Energy distance across response-embedding samples, permutation tests and sequential evidence aggregation
metric_result: Section6.2: four tested change types trigger on next fingerprint; small temperature .7 to.6 change detected after18 fingerprints. Not a population accuracy estimate.
baselines_generalization: Family,version,inference-engine,quantization,temperature interventions; provider comparisons. Endpoint routing/batching can confound attribution.
statistics: Permutation p-values aggregated sequentially; comprehensive power/false-alarm estimates NR-V in this scoped extraction.
defense_retraining_cost_utility: NA for privacy defense;800 calls/fingerprint is monitoring call cost, not bandwidth or utility preservation.
artifact: Stability Monitor/Stability Arena described; artifact/run binding and reproduction NR-V/NR-P.
limits_todos: Do not equate runtime cause of output change with a metadata-only feature. DOI10.1145/3786335.3813194 publisher equivalence not verified.

title: StepFinder: A Temporal Semantic Framework for Failure Attribution in Multi-Agent Systems
observer_permissions: Privileged failed-trajectory receiver with complete action/interaction content and agent identity
signal_origin: Semantic interaction embeddings plus agent identity/order and learned temporal features
hidden_property: Root-cause step and responsible agent in failed task trajectory
evaluation_conditions: Who&When Algorithm-Generated and Hand-Crafted subsets; training task sets92/186, generated trajectories1564/2604; task-disjoint training/test stated. Text Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B plus sequence/attention model.
evidence_boundary: Mixed semantic/structural diagnostic model. Table5 removes modules but retains content embeddings; no independently evaluated content-free structural branch established.
RQ2: Privileged complete-trajectory receiver; no ordinary website observer claim
RQ3: Task-disjoint diagnosis on two subsets; temporal-module ablation is not a structural-only attack result
RQ4: Diagnosis, not confidentiality defense; privacy utility-cost frontier NA
decision_rule: C1-C5 component adjudication; mixed-feature C3 boundary
decision_reason: C1 agent trajectories,C2 root-cause step,C4 documented full-log receiver,C5 held-out attribution experiment qualify. C3 independent auxiliary component remains unestablished: content embeddings persist in all Table5 component removals. Adjacent semantics-plus-order diagnostic comparator, not excluded for authorized purpose.
trace_source: Who&When failed-agent trajectories with step content and agent identifiers
system_sample_split: Task-disjoint train/test as stated in5.1; training92Alg/186HC tasks generating1564/2604 trajectories. Exact test-denominator reconciliation NR-V in this extraction.
method: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B content encoder,agent embeddings,BiLSTM,agent-aware attention,multiscale differencing,position bias and future-step auxiliary loss
metric_result: Table5 accuracy: StepFinder29.63%Alg/22.99%HC; without temporal extraction25.13%/12.64%. These are mixed-content attribution scores, not metadata-only leakage.
baselines_generalization: Random,LLM-based and sequence models; Table5 module ablations; no weak-observer/content-free transfer established.
statistics: Accuracy/tolerance accuracy/top-k/MRR; detailed interval/seed aggregation NR-V in this scoped extraction.
defense_retraining_cost_utility: Privacy-defense NA; published diagnostic efficiency is not suppression of private-goal inference.
artifact: Source links https://github.com/taiyu-zhu/StepFinder and DOI10.5281/zenodo.20432323; not executed or run-bound here.
limits_todos: Keep synthetic training labels,task-disjoint protocol and semantic access explicit. DOI10.1145/3770855.3817991 exact-version equivalence NR-V.
